apps.localizedDescription:
PeonPad does not include Warcraft II. To play, you provide data extracted from your own legally owned copy on a Mac or PC. That game content stays local to your machine and is never part of the PeonPad download.

AI disclosure: PeonPad uses substantial AI assistance for code, tests, documentation, debugging and maintenance. Some support replies and maintenance tasks are automated. There is no audited percentage of AI-generated code. Build, test and device records describe what was checked. This disclosure concerns PeonPad's workflow, not the authorship of its upstream projects.

What is PeonPad?:

PeonPad is an independent Apple-platform Warcraft II port built on the open-source Stratagus engine and Wargus game layer. It runs engine code directly on iPadOS; it does not run a Windows executable, emulate x86, or stream a game from another computer.

versions.localizedDescription:
PeonPad 0.1.0 Preview 1 is the first public unsigned IPA build.

Important:

• The IPA is unsigned. It must be signed with your own Apple account or a sideloading service you trust before installation.
• The IPA contains no Warcraft II data, Aleona data, installer, MPQ, save, provisioning profile, or signing credential.
• You must own Warcraft II and separately extract a complete data.Wargus folder on a computer.
• After installing, copy that folder to On My iPad > PeonPad > data.Wargus through Files or Finder, then relaunch PeonPad.
• iPadOS 16 or later is required.

What changed:

• Added a data-free iOS distribution build, strict app audit, and deterministic IPA packager.

• Kept embedded game data behind an explicit private-development build mode.

Validation:

• The app and IPA audits rejected prohibited game/private/signing content and local build paths.
• Two independently packaged clean-clone IPAs were byte-identical.
• A physical M2 iPad Pro passed in-place install, missing-data messaging, byte-verified user-data transfer, title/menu launch, and preference-value preservation.
